name: Supabase
aliases: Backend as a Service with Supabase

beginner.summary: For developers who know basic SQL and JavaScript or TypeScript and are new to Supabase. Covers creating a project, the dashboard, the auto-generated Data API, supabase-js, Supabase Auth with email and OAuth, JWTs and sessions, Row Level Security with the anon, authenticated and service_role roles, the profiles-on-signup trigger, embedded resources, Storage buckets and policies, Realtime Postgres Changes, local development and migrations with the Supabase CLI, generated types, database functions through rpc, server-side auth in Next.js, and a task-tracker capstone.
prerequisites: Writes basic SQL: CREATE TABLE, INSERT, SELECT with WHERE and JOIN
Reads and writes JavaScript or TypeScript with async/await and can run npm commands
Has a laptop with Node.js (current LTS), Git, a browser, a free Supabase account and, for local work, Docker Desktop or another Docker-compatible runtime
outcomes: Create and configure a Supabase project, design tables and call them through the Data API and supabase-js
Sign users in with Supabase Auth and protect every table with correct Row Level Security policies
Store files in Storage buckets and push live changes to clients with Realtime
Develop locally with the Supabase CLI, commit migrations and ship a working application with server-side auth
